key_highlights: ASX slumps as bond yields spike; unemployment hits 5-year high, pressuring banks and miners
RBA signals continued hikes despite rising unemployment, trapping borrowers in a rate pincer
AUD under severe pressure – 'trapdoor opens' and 'pulverised by US boom' signals sharp depreciation
House prices over halfway to largest 40-year decline; over half of renters financially stressed
Trump effect widening cracks in global financial markets; China's response adds geopolitical risk
Mining exploration positive: Rio2 Peruvian copper drill, Auric high-grade gold at Munda, Sarytogan 452m copper, Forrestania 210k oz gold resource
Intergenerational Report 2026 flags urgent tax reform need; energy hysteria around data centre demand

sectors.trend: CBA, NAB, ANZ, WBC under pressure from rising unemployment, rate pincer squeezing NIMs, and bond yield spike increasing funding costs. Credit risk rising with renter stress.
sectors.implications: Earnings pressure on NIMs; higher provision costs likely. Defensive dividend yield support but growth outlook weak.

sectors.trend: Large caps (BHP, RIO, FMG) weighed down by Wall Street spillover and AUD weakness. However, exploration names show strong pipeline: Rio2 copper, Auric gold, Sarytogan copper, Forrestania gold, Lindian rare earths.
sectors.implications: AUD weakness supports commodity exporters' AUD revenue. Exploration upside offers speculative opportunity; majors face near-term headwinds.

sectors.trend: Data centre boom driving energy demand but 'energy hysteria' and potential supply constraints. Energy prices volatile.
sectors.implications: Energy producers (SAP, WDS, AGL) benefit from demand surge but face capex pressure. Watch for policy intervention.

sectors.trend: Jetstar industrial action escalating; Qantas outback pricing complaints. Consumer squeeze from rate pincer and renter stress.
sectors.implications: QAN.AX and JTA.AX face margin pressure from industrial action and pricing disputes. Consumer discretionary under pressure.

sectors.trend: House prices over halfway to largest 40-year fall; Dusty Martin selling $20m portfolio; historic CBD tower listed at $40m.
sectors.implications: Residential REITs (OGP, VMC, GPT) face cap value pressure. Commercial REITs mixed. Rate pincer suppresses demand.

sectors.trend: Global AI chip race intensifying (Nvidia, AMD, Intel, Lumentum). Salesforce 'New Clippy' launch. AI workplace integration accelerating.
sectors.implications: Limited direct ASX exposure but benefits CSL, WES via digital transformation. Global tech volatility spills into ASX.

key_themes: RBA rate pincer: hiking into rising unemployment creates borrower distress and credit risk
AUD depreciation: sharp weakness from US strength and Trump policy uncertainty
Bond yield spike: potential equity de-rating risk ('will bonds crash stocks')
Trump geopolitical effect: market cracks widening, China response adds risk
Housing correction: 40-year high decline underway, renter stress at 50%+
Mining exploration pipeline: strong copper and gold discoveries across WA, Peru, Kazakhstan
Intergenerational Report: fiscal sustainability concerns, tax reform imperative
Energy demand shock from data centres

risk_assessment.risk_factor: RBA hiking into recession / unemployment spike
risk_assessment.mitigation: Overweight quality dividend payers; reduce leverage exposure; monitor RBA statement for pivot signals
Hedge AUD exposure; favour commodity exporters (BHP, RIO) whose USD revenue benefits from weak AUD

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Bond yield spike triggering equity de-rating
risk_assessment.mitigation: Reduce duration-sensitive growth stocks; favour short-duration and value; monitor 10yr GBA yield
Underweight residential REITs and home loan-heavy banks; monitor NIM and provision trends
Diversify geographically; hold gold (GOLD.AX, NGT.AX) as hedge; monitor China response

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Energy supply constraints from data centre demand
risk_assessment.mitigation: Monitor energy prices; consider energy producers as inflation hedge

opportunities.recommendation: Overweight large-cap miners benefiting from AUD weakness and commodity strength
opportunities.rationale: AUD 'trapdoor' and 'pulverised' by US boom directly boosts AUD-denominated earnings of USD-revenue miners

opportunities.recommendation: Selective exposure to gold and copper exploration names with strong recent discoveries
opportunities.rationale: Auric high-grade gold, Sarytogan 452m copper, Forrestania 210k oz, Rio2 Peruvian copper – pipeline de-risking

opportunities.recommendation: Add gold as portfolio hedge amid geopolitical and currency uncertainty
opportunities.rationale: Trump effect, AUD weakness, and bond volatility support gold; Vista Gold sale signals sector M&A activity

defensive_moves.recommendation: Reduce exposure to residential REITs and rate-sensitive growth equities
defensive_moves.rationale: 40-year house price decline underway, renter stress at 50%+, bond yield spike pressures valuations

defensive_moves.recommendation: Trim consumer discretionary and transport exposure amid industrial action and rate pincer
defensive_moves.rationale: Jetstar industrial action, Qantas pricing disputes, and borrower stress suppress consumer spending

defensive_moves.recommendation: Maintain cash buffer and short-duration bonds to navigate rate uncertainty
defensive_moves.rationale: RBA still hiking despite 5-year high unemployment; bond yields spiking creates volatility

market_outlook.short_term: ASX likely to remain under pressure from bond yield spike, AUD weakness, and unemployment data. Banks and miners lead declines. Expect volatility around RBA commentary and US market spillover. Gold and commodity exporters relatively resilient.
market_outlook.long_term: Rate pincer and housing correction may force RBA pivot within 6–12 months. Intergenerational Report tax reform could reshape fiscal landscape. Mining exploration pipeline supports medium-term materials sector. Energy demand from data centres creates structural tailwind. AUD likely to stabilise once US growth normalises.

Trump policy actions and China response

Core CPI and retail sales data
Iron ore, copper, gold spot prices
US bond yields and Trump policy announcements
